scope: Design-only preset-home filter proposals; no application edits or build.

variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Produce one high-fidelity, believable Android app screen design image, portrait 1080x2424 proportion, straight-on flat UI screenshot, sharp readable Simplified Chinese text. This is a design proposal for Huevia's existing PRESET home, not an actual implemented screenshot. Use referenced image 1 as strict visual authority for warm-paper background #FAF9F6, charcoal #25241F, subtle warm grey, type scale, existing two-column photography masonry and floating pill bottom navigation. Image 2 is supporting reference for the ONLINE presets content. Preserve the home hierarchy and existing sizes: compact status bar, title "预设" with search and plus actions at upper right, segmented "在线预设" selected / "我的预设", horizontal compact categories "全部 人像 风景 胶片 黑白 日常 夜景", the "发现色彩" row, photo cards and labels, bottom floating nav "预设 同步 相册 设置" with the whole first icon-and-label selected charcoal. No extra hero, banner, promotional copy or new permanent rows. Keep photography large. In the existing "发现色彩" row right, keep a small muted result count "36 份" and add only one compact 20px sliders/filter line icon with a tiny active dot within an invisible 48dp touch target. This is the same entry location in all three variants. Do not use a native Android AlertDialog, native radio list, checkboxes, oversized buttons, giant type or deep black full-screen panel. Text precise and aligned, all control labels fit one line. Use neutral charcoal selected pills with white text, small check mark at the END inside the selected pill, consistent 4px concentric inset if inside tracks, no adjoining selected backgrounds. Panel copy EXACT: title "筛选", section label "风格", choices "全部" "人像" "风景" "胶片" "黑白" "日常" "夜景" "未分类", selected "胶片"; section label "下载状态", choices "全部" "未下载" "已下载", selected "未下载". Footer actions exact "重置" and "应用", compact and proportional, primary application charcoal. No NCP/NP3 classifications, camera model filters, ratings or unverified counts. Keep existing header, tabs, card grid and bottom-nav geometry unchanged behind the overlay. Make the overlay the only redesign. No external phone hardware frame or perspective, no annotations, no A/B/C label inside screen.
VARIANT A — ANCHORED PAPER POPOVER. A small custom floating warm-white card anchored just below the filter icon in the discovery/count row. Card about 310dp wide by 292dp high, placed in upper-middle right over only the top photo area, 18-22dp corner radius, delicate warm shadow and hairline border. No dark scrim; surrounding page remains visible and bright. Header title left and small close x right on one baseline. Categories in a tidy 4-column by 2-row matrix of small soft-grey content-size capsules, equal gaps 8dp. Download status in one 3-column row. Quiet bottom rule; compact text Reset left and 88x36dp Apply button right. Very refined low-occupancy utility popup, not a large modal. Active category and undownloaded state both fully contained, all margins exact. Background photography untouched.

VARIANT B — FLOATING FROSTED BOTTOM SHEET. Compact custom panel floats 12dp from side edges and 14dp above bottom safe inset. About 320dp high, rounded 28dp corners. Milky semi-transparent warm white glass with restrained true backdrop blur, thin luminous inner rim, subtle warm shadow; underlying photography faintly visible through material, but readable dark text. The existing floating navigation is naturally covered by this temporary sheet, its original geometry is not moved. Very light scrim only over the background. Tiny centered grabber, title left and small close right. Small section labels, category chips arranged 4x2 with 8dp gaps, selected chips charcoal and white, no peach. Download status three small separated capsule options. Compact footer, Reset low contrast at left and Apply as restrained 120x40dp charcoal pill right. No full-width giant CTA, no explanatory paragraphs. Keep upper half homepage completely visible so user understands context. The sheet should look bespoke and photography-oriented.

VARIANT C — COMPACT SIDE DRAWER. An elegant custom right-edge floating drawer, width approximately 76 percent of screen (296dp), begins below status bar with 12dp top/right/bottom margins, 26dp left and right corners, warm-white opaque paper material and subtle outline. It overlays the existing screen, does not compress or reflow the underlying masonry. Leftmost 20 percent remains visibly recognizable preset home with very light scrim. Header title and small x close on one line. Drawer has quiet vertical spacing, category choices as a tidy 2-column matrix of compact individual pills with 8dp gaps, 36dp painted height; selected category charcoal with tiny trailing check. Download-state choices as three short clean one-line option rows with custom small trailing outlined ring/filled dot, each 44dp target, no native RadioButton look. A subtle inset divider separates sections. Footer near lower portion uses small Reset text and compact 100x38dp Apply pill on one baseline, not enormous, no redundant help copy or empty placeholder cards. This option should feel organized and calm for longer filter lists. Keep the background home geometry fixed.

compactCRevision.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Edit the supplied Chinese Huevia preset-home concept screenshot with ONE focused change: make the right-edge filter drawer much more compact. Preserve the existing screen size, warm paper/charcoal palette, original home header/tabs/photo masonry and floating bottom navigation. Do not redesign the app. Replace the nearly full-height drawer with a content-height right-edge floating card about 296dp wide and only 385dp tall, positioned around the upper-middle over the photographs, beginning just below the discovery row. Top and bottom of the home remain clearly visible. No wasted empty vertical expanse. Rounded 22dp corners, thin warm-grey outline and soft restrained shadow, no large black backdrop. Give the card a right-edge slide-in character, without an arrow pointer. Everything inside uses compact Chinese typography: title "筛选" 16sp with small close x, section labels "风格" and "下载状态" 12sp muted. Eight compact equal two-column pills, 32dp painted height, 8dp gaps, labels exact "全部" "人像" "风景" "胶片" "黑白" "日常" "夜景" "未分类". Select "胶片" with a charcoal pill, white text and tiny trailing check. Category text 13sp. Below a quiet divider, use three horizontally aligned SEPARATED small pills for "全部" "未下载" "已下载", select "未下载" charcoal with white text; no radio rows and no Android radio-circle widgets. Footer directly below content with no large intervening gap: "重置" text left and a small 88x34dp "应用" charcoal pill right. Card padding 16dp, exact alignment. The background online/home may stay visible behind the custom panel; do not add another permanent row or alter existing card sizes. The three download pills must fit one line, no overly large text or controls. This is high-fidelity visual design concept C, not a native system dialog, no annotations or device frame. Output one portrait screen.
compactCRevision.disposition: Not selected: generated background changed tab wording and masonry columns. Original full-height side drawer retained as C; no further iteration.
